title: ON.energy mono button
description: A 40px button with a small mono label and 4px corners: translucent glass over media, a solid block on light sections, or black-and-yellow on yellow. On hover a yellow fill slides in from the left with an expo-out ease, the label turns black and a soft yellow glow appears.
notes: CSS only; the sweep is instant under reduced motion
glass looks best over dark media or dark sections
name: on-energy-button

props.name: children
props.description: the label, set in the mono face

props.name: variant
props.description:
glass: translucent foreground over media or dark sections ·
solid: background-coloured block (black on the light sections) ·
ink: primary-foreground block with primary text (black and yellow, for yellow sections)
